fixes.target: figure-1: Route map for adequate control
fixes.value: Flow chart titled 'Figure 1 Route map for adequate control'. It starts with two boxes side by side: 'What substances/products do you use at work and for what tasks?' and 'What substances are generated by the work or processes?', each noting you only need to record this if you have more than five employees and use or generate no substances. Both lead to the question 'Is there simple information or guidance available in the form of COSHH essentials control guidance sheets...?'; 'Yes' leads to 'Are you already following the guidance or are you able to implement the controls in the guidance easily and without help?', and 'Yes' there leads to 'Record what you are doing (if you have more than five employees) and review if there are any changes.' A 'No' at either question leads to 'You may need to seek competent advice to help you identify adequate control.' followed by recording what you are doing and reviewing for changes.
